main_text.p: ri æmulo ex communi præda confultum. Hoc in genere. In specie autem adnitendum esse, vt commissis inter sese Saxonicis Principibus, potentia eorum frangatur. Id autem fieri posse commodissimè. 1. Si Primatus Magdeburgicus, qui nunc vacat, Electori Coloniensi Bavaro decernatur administrandus. id neq; Brandeburgicus, neque Saxo facilè concesserint. 2. Id si non succedat pro votis, aliquid caussæ obtendendum, quàre videatur aut videri debeat, ab Electorali dignitate remouendus Saxo. Si enim olim Imperii Proceres à Cæsareo culmine deiecerunt Wenceslaum, quia ipsis videbatur ignauior; habere etiam posse Cæsare iustam caussam, quare Saxonem istum quotidie ebrium ab Electorali dignitate remoueat. Tradat & restituat igitur hanc dignitatem familiæ Winmariensi, Et quia Principes adhuc minorennes, administrationem committat Electuræ Henrico Brunsuicensi Principi litterato & vigilanti. Hæc res sine dubio incredibiles excitabit turbas per totam Saxoniam. Ita mutuis se conficient & atterét viribus, vt communi nox superuenturo hosti, refistere. nequeant. Brandeburgicū & Pomeranos quod attinet, dandâ operam, vt affinis Cæsaris Rex Poloniæ, cum patruo suo Rege Swecìæ Carolo sic pacifcatur, vt Prussiam communi sectioni subiiciant, & in capita diuidant, contra quod se Brandeburgicus totis viribus opponet. Has-siæ verò Landgrauium adurgendum, vt cum[?]

page.notes: The first word is a fragment continued from the previous page. Numerals "1." and "2." are printed in the margin-like position inside the text and are kept inline. The printed "2" is a worn ligature and is read as 2. The final word "cum" is partly worn at the line end. The printed word "Brandeburgicū" and "Brandeburgicus" are kept as printed. No marginal notes are visible. No catchword is printed separately.
